name: popsicle
headline: Marketing Resources: SaaS Growth & Launch
short_description: Curated collection of marketing resources including guides, books, blogs, and launch platforms for SaaS and startup growth.
author: benfreu

sections.overview:
Marketing Resources is a curated directory of marketing materials, guides, and tools designed for SaaS marketers and startup founders. It aggregates content marketing strategies, SEO best practices, launch checklists, and a comprehensive list of platforms where you can promote your product. The collection includes links to established marketing blogs, B2B SaaS playbooks, content distribution checklists, and 100+ communities and platforms for product launches. Whether you're planning a product launch, building your content strategy, or seeking growth inspiration, this resource hub provides vetted recommendations to accelerate your marketing efforts.
Planning a product launch across 50+ platforms
Building a content marketing and SEO strategy
Finding startup-friendly communities for product promotion
Creating and executing a content distribution plan
